title: DAO storm window: temporary per-source limit increase after topology change
description: Problem: When a parent change happens, multiple children send DAOs nearly simultaneously. Forward buffer per-source limit of 2 is correct for steady state but a topology event is bursty. Children DAOs get dropped, slowing routing convergence. Fix: When RPL detects a parent change (DIO with new preferred parent, or local parent switch), enter a 'DAO storm' window of 5-10 seconds where the per-source forward buffer limit temporarily doubles (2→4). After the window expires, revert to steady-state limit. No new data structure — just a timestamp + conditional in the existing forward buffer admission check. Spec impact: document in appendix-rpl.md and appendix-bufferbloat.md.
design: Trigger: parent_changed event (already exists in RPL stack). Duration: CONFIG_LICHEN_DAO_STORM_WINDOW_MS default 5000. Implementation: forward_buffer.try_buffer() checks if now < storm_deadline; if so, uses limit=4 instead of limit=2. No per-source state change — just the admission threshold. Python: ForwardingBuffer gets storm_until timestamp. Rust: ForwardBuffer gets storm_deadline_ms. C: forward buffer struct gets storm_deadline field.
